winter.thin_items_cull: visibility_range_end at the cluster detail band (cluster radius + load margin)

policy.included: generated static opaque buildings (mesh kind building, regen_action generate) of the listed chunks
policy.authored: excluded: features with an authored scene (727 Fort St, Fort Zachary Taylor, and any keep/keep_locked/needs_rebase asset) stay Tier 0 in their chunk and are listed in the manifest; manual proxies are phase 2
policy.props: excluded: Reality props are 0.15 m cylinders already batched as one MultiMesh per chunk; at the switch distance they cover about one pixel
policy.windows: excluded from proxies: facade panes are under a pixel at the proxy distance

sources.cluster_m: baseline 2026-10-14 (docs/technical/REALITY_HLOD.md): 512 m and 1024 m clusters never leave detail while their chunk is loaded; 128 m cuts the estimated building draw calls on the route by 76 %
sources.chunks: 2026-10-15, owner request: island-wide. Every chunk with at least one generated building (mesh kind building) in the editor export, 114 chunks; was the 2x2 Old Town block -6:1 -5:1 -6:2 -5:2 that showed -41..-67 % draw calls (docs/technical/REALITY_HLOD.md).
